description.short: Hand multi-step work on your files to Parallel Frontier; get the results back.
description.full: Hand long, multi-step work on your files to Parallel Frontier's self-optimizing agents: research, analysis, document production and your organization's playbooks. Frontier runs the task end to end, asks when it needs you, and hands back the finished files.

agentConnectors.description: Parallel Frontier's task tools: start, follow, answer, steer and stop a Frontier task, list playbooks and recent tasks, and move files in and out. Sign in with your Frontier account.
